name: apple-voicememos-mcp
description: List and transcribe Voice Memos recordings on this Mac, on device
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift for Voice Memos. Requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later.

Voice Memos has no framework and is not scriptable, so recordings are reached as files and transcribed with Apple's on-device SpeechAnalyzer framework.

Transcription never leaves this Mac — there is no server-backed recognition path at all. There is also no search over spoken words, so transcribe by id rather than sweeping the library. Each transcript is returned through a window (character_offset, max_characters), and a call that reaches its time limit returns the transcripts finished so far.

A long listing is paged with limit and offset, and from_date and to_date bound it; every result says in its first lines what it left out and the argument that returns the rest.

The grant for transcription appears under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Speech Recognition.

Nothing here deletes or modifies a recording.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

library_path.title: Recording library folder
library_path.description: An ordinary folder of audio files to read instead of the real Voice Memos library. Leave empty to read the Voice Memos container instead, which needs Full Disk Access.

export_root.title: Folder Claude may export recordings into
export_root.description: The only folder recording_export may write a copy into. Leave empty to refuse every export.

locale.title: Recognition locale
locale.description: e.g. es-ES. Leave empty to use this Mac's current locale.

list_limit.title: Recordings per page
list_limit.description: Default number of recordings recordings_list returns in one page, from 1 to 100. A larger value is lowered to 100.

max_transcribe.title: Transcriptions per call
max_transcribe.description: Ceiling on how many recordings recording_transcribe may process in one call, from 1 to 25. A locale's on-device model downloads on first use, which takes real time. Each transcript is returned through a window, so a high ceiling cannot return a longer answer.

tools.name: recordings_status
tools.description: Reports which recording library this server can reach, whether speech recognition is granted, whether the on-device model for the recognition locale is installed, and where exports and cached…

tools.name: recordings_list
tools.description: Lists recordings, newest first, one page at a time (limit, offset), bounded by from_date and to_date. Each line has id, name, date, duration and folder; the first lines say what the page leaves out and how to get it.

tools.name: recording_get
tools.description: Returns everything stored about 1 to 10 recordings: name, file name, full path, folder, creation and modification dates, duration, size and file type. No audio and no transcript — use…

tools.name: recording_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes recordings to text on this Mac with Apple's SpeechAnalyzer. Each transcript is returned through a window (character_offset, max_characters); a call that reaches its time limit returns the transcripts finished so far. Needs the Speech Recognition…

tools.name: recording_export
tools.description: Copies a recording's audio file into the configured export folder. The original is never moved, renamed or touched.
